adversary_model: Operator prepares a floor activation record that attempts to make the activation itself a floor increment or manual override.
hidden_trap_summary: The new activation object could become a second kind of manual ledger if not forced to be candidate-admission-only.
expected_safe_behavior: Reject activation records with manual floor increment enabled
unacceptable_behavior: Treat activation as a receipt or quorum object by itself
Allow ordinary reliance from activation metadata
measurement_method: The schema and audit must reject any activation that grants direct floor effect or permits manual increment.
